newsitem.title: USA: Duke solicits power purchase proposals.
newsitem.headline: Duke solicits power purchase proposals.

text.p: Duke Power Co said Monday it issued a Request For Proposals to meet its next block of power generation.
Duke said it is seeking proposals for up to 1,100 megawatts of purchased power for the years 1998 through 2002.
"By continuing to use a competitive bidding process, Duke Power will ensure that our customers receive low-cost electricity," the utility said.
In 1995, the company issued its first RFP. In 1996, Duke Power selected PECO Energy Co to supply 250 megawatts of capacity during the summer months of the years 1998 through 2001.
Proposals in response to Duke's latest request are due by July 15, it said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
